description: This is a test source file for the LocationHandler class, containing unit tests for location permission handling, accuracy preferences, and error scenarios in an Android application.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for LocationHandler, testing various permission and location retrieval scenarios.

classes.name: FakeLocationDataSource
classes.description: A fake implementation of LocationDataSource for testing purposes, simulating permission states and location fetch behavior.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Test that location fetching requires permissions when neither fine nor coarse permissions are granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Test that background location is only available when foreground permission is granted.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Test that the permission check correctly reflects the data source permission states.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Test that precise GPS is used first when permissions are granted and precise mode is enabled.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Test fallback behavior to less precise location providers when precise is unavailable.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Test that a timeout during location fetch maps to a LOCATION_TIMEOUT error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Test that other failures are mapped to LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE errors.
